tim_cust: Hey @support — uploaded a 10k-row CSV via the bulk-embed endpoint yesterday and the invoice shows ~12.3k embeddings. Also noticed rerank jobs returning mixed vector lengths (1536 and 1024) in the same job. Sample request_id: r-0a1b2c3d, rerank id rr-99a8b. Uploaded file s3://cust-bucket/embeds/2026-03-16.csv. Invoice INV-2026-03-15-789. Can you help?

sara_support: Sorry about that, will look. Can you paste the top 5 request IDs + the exact SDK/curl call you used? Also a redacted CSV sample that reproduces and the invoice line id.

tim_cust: Request ids: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0a1b2c3e, r-0a1b2c3f, r-0a1b2c40, r-0a1b2c41. SDK call (redacted):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="***")
client.embeddings.create(model='embed-lite', input=open('batch.csv','rb'), batch_size=200)
```
Used default alias `embed-lite`. Invoice line INV-2026-03-15-789. I can share small sample attached.

ashley_ml: FWIW we've seen two root causes here in other reports:
- alias routing: `embed-lite` alias can map to multiple backend model ids (e.g., embed-1536 and embed-1024) during deploys, so large batches split and end up on different dims.
- rerank pairwise billing: if rerank was used in pairwise mode, pairs are billed per pair and can be aggregated into embeddings usage in older billing mappings.
Can you confirm whether you used `strategy='pairwise'` on the rerank job?

 tim_cust: I did use `rerank` with `strategy='pairwise'` for one workload (rr-99a8b). Bulk embed upload was a separate job though. For the curl test I can run a quick repro.

lee_eng: Paging infra team. Please provide the metering trace for r-0a1b2c3d and rr-99a8b. If embedding pipeline logged `model_used` per batch we can confirm routing. Also check `embed-split` logs for batch splits (/var/log/embed-split.log).

maria_billing: I pulled the invoice lines: INV-2026-03-15-789 shows 12,345 embed units billed, CSV had 10,000 rows. There's an extra `pair_count` of 2,345 that looks like it came from rerank pairwise and got merged into embed lines due to legacy aggregation. Provisional delta estimate: $1,250. Opening a billing ticket now.

ashley_ml: We should add a dim-invariant check in metering: all vectors for a given request_id should have consistent dimension; emit `metering.dim_invariant_violation` when not. I'll prototype a quick alert rule.

 sara_support: Tim — please run this repro command and paste the output (include any `X-Trace-Id`):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer KEY' \
  -F 'file=@sample.csv' \
  -F 'model=embed-lite' \
  -F 'batch_size=200' \
  -H 'X-Trace-Id: <your-trace-id>'
```

 tim_cust: Ran it, got 200 and trace `trace-8f7e`. Response snippet: `vector_lengths: [1536,1536,1536,1024,1024]`. So indeed first batches returned 1536, then some 1024.

lee_eng: Confirmed trace-8f7e — backend routed portions of the batch to two model backends. Root cause: during a rolling upgrade the alias `embed-lite` temporarily pointed to both embed-1536 and embed-1024 pools. Autoscaler split the incoming payload and fallback pool had the older 1024 model. Also found billing mapping that aggregates pairwise rerank into embeddings lines.

maria_billing: :eyes: I'll apply a provisional credit to INV-2026-03-15-789 while we sort the separation. How would you like the credit applied (full delta or partial)? BT ticket will be BT-4567.

 sara_support: Proposed action items: 
- Eng (lee_eng): hotfix to pin alias to single model id (rollback the mixed mapping).
- ML infra (ashley_ml): add metering dim invariant + alert + unit test.
- Billing (maria_billing): separate pairwise rerank lines and provisional credit.
- Support (sara_support): coordinate customer comms and postmortem.
If that sounds good I'll escalate to P1 and move to #incidents.

lee_eng: Will push alias-pin hotfix in next 15m and roll back the mixed mapping. PR: infra/alias-pin-1994. :thumbsup:

ashley_ml: I'll add the invariant check and a quick replay job to scan last 72h for violations; will auto-assign to eng-runtime if we see anything. PR queued.

maria_billing: Provisional credit applied for INV-2026-03-15-789: $1,250. Billing ticket BT-4567 created to reconcile line items separately.

 tim_cust: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Happy to re-run tests after the fix.

 sara_support: :white_check_mark: Moving this thread to #incidents and DMing tim when fix is live. Will follow up with a short postmortem once we have the root cause and timeline. Thanks all!"
